attr.title: Alex the Allegator 2
attr.desc: A mouse-driven puzzle game for one or two players. Place and slide tokens on the board to clear your own color, but watch your score - you need the higher one to win.
attr.desc_md: A mouse-driven puzzle game by [Johan Peitz](http://allegator.sourceforge.net/), made for the 2001 "Allegro Speedhack" jam. Place your tokens on the board or slide a row/column in turn, trying to wipe the board of your own color while keeping the higher score. Watch out for the gray stone tokens, and use the yellow multi-tokens wisely.
attr.inst: Ready to run. Entirely mouse-driven - the left stick moves a cursor and A clicks. Two-player works fine on one controller since both players share the same cursor in turn.
